summary: Retain test producer cgroup memory baselines and failure diagnostics without changing compilation or runner routing.

replay.detail: CI diagnostic evidence only; no runtime, routing or compilation-policy change.

manual.detail: On producer build-step failure inspect the test-build-memory artifact and job log. A positive job-cgroup oom_kill delta is a strong lead; zero or UNKNOWN does not rule OOM out when the compiler/cache server or Nix build is in another cgroup. Kernel termination evidence is not collected; cumulative counters and peaks alone do not establish OOM.

recovery.detail: The original build verdict is preserved; diagnostic failures are advisory and no compilation is retried.
